qwen3_tts.language_note: Ten documented languages; voice and accent coverage vary by variant.

breeze_tts.language_note: English and Mandarin Chinese. Cloning requires a matching reference transcript.

fish_audio.language_note: Upstream reports 80+ languages. Runtime examples concentrate on English and Chinese; equal quality across languages is not established.

chatterbox.language_note: Languages advertised by the pinned audio.cpp route; newer upstream Chatterbox variants may differ.

chatterbox_turbo.language_note: English only. The audio.cpp package uses its embedded voice and rejects cloning references.

supertonic.language_note: 31 documented languages and ten preset voices. Review the licence use restrictions.

pocket_tts.language_note: Language belongs to the selected package. Source weights may require accepting upstream access terms.

voxcpm2.language_note: Upstream lists 30 languages and Chinese dialects; prompt conventions affect delivery.

magpie_tts.language_note: Use the language coverage of the installed release; newer upstream Magpie cards describe different revisions.

omnivoice.language_note: Upstream claims 646+ languages; per-language quality is not independently verified here. Streaming is chunked rather than native continuous generation.

fireredtts3.language_note: Cloning and voice design use different templates. With a reference recording, audio.cpp 0.8.1 uses the instruction slot for its transcript; additional delivery directions are unavailable.

kokoro_tts.language_note: Preset voices and language-specific phonemization; voice IDs must match the selected language.

irodori_tts.language_note: Japanese only. Native caption directions depend on checkpoint support and are not yet translated by Pandrator.

cosyvoice3.language_note: Language is inferred from text by this audio.cpp route. Instructions select the instruct template.

qwen3_tts_1_7b_base_q8_0.description: Clone a reference voice in ten languages. Choose CustomVoice or an expressive model when delivery instructions matter.

qwen3_tts_0_6b_base_q8_0.description: The smaller Qwen Base variant for reference-voice narration. It still has a sizeable tokenizer and model download.

qwen3_tts_1_7b_customvoice_q8_0.description: Nine built-in voices with natural-language delivery instructions. Existing cloned cast references must be reassigned.

qwen3_tts_1_7b_voicedesign_q8_0.recommended_for: Create a voice from a description
qwen3_tts_1_7b_voicedesign_q8_0.description: Describe a voice and synthesize a sample without reference audio. Save a chosen sample for a stable reusable voice.

breeze_tts_2_q8_0.description: Natural-language direction with optional cloning. A matching reference transcript is required for cloning; model weights have noncommercial terms.

fish_audio_s2_pro_q8_0.description: Free-form delivery tags and vocal events, with optional reference voices. Large download; commercial use needs a separate licence.

chatterbox_turbo_q8_0.recommended_for: Fast English with an embedded voice
chatterbox_turbo_q8_0.description: A compact distilled English model with documented vocal-event tags and an embedded voice. Custom voice cloning is unavailable in this audio.cpp route.

supertonic_3_q8_0.description: A small model with 31 languages and ten preset voices. Suitable as a starting point when cloning is unnecessary.

pocket_tts_english_q8_0.recommended_for: Small English model for CPU use
pocket_tts_english_q8_0.description: A compact English model with preset voices and cloning. A useful starting point on machines with limited GPU memory.

kokoro_82m_q8_0.description: Small preset-voice synthesis with language-specific voice choices. No cloning or natural-language voice design.
